title: Minnesota contractors: Master-license identity with contact safeguards
hypothesis: MN DLI Electrical and Plumbing Master-level, Issued license rows can establish a license-role and published business-contact candidate. A Personal licensee, a Business row, and a register phone do not independently establish business ownership, handset ownership, mobile line type, or permission to contact a person.
ownerSource: MN DLI Licensee Name on a Personal Master-level license is a named license-role candidate only. Business rows have no named person, and neither row type independently confirms ownership.
phoneSource: MN DLI Phone_No is a published business-contact candidate. The catalog reports reuse up to 189 licenses, so it cannot be treated as a direct or exclusive owner phone without a distinct-business/person reuse gate and all downstream contact gates.

workflow.label: MN DLI source and category gate
workflow.detail: Use only eligible Electrical or Plumbing CSVs. Hold an HTTP-success HTML error page, unavailable category, or source whose terms cannot be confirmed.

workflow.label: Current Issued Master license?
workflow.detail: Require Issued status, a Master-level subtype, and a parsed expiration date current through its stated date. Do not widen the documented Master cohort to non-Master contractor rows.

workflow.label: Hold inactive, non-Master, or malformed license
workflow.detail: Do not use expired, non-Issued, unsupported-class, or malformed-date rows as contractor candidates.

workflow.label: License role classification
workflow.detail: A Personal row is a named license-role candidate; a Business row is business-only. Neither establishes an owner.

workflow.label: Hold business-only owner claim
workflow.detail: Keep Business rows and unsupported ownership claims out of an owner-confirmed branch.

workflow.label: Published-phone reuse gate
workflow.detail: Treat Phone_No as a business-contact candidate only. Hold absent, shared, or over-threshold phone values before verification.

workflow.label: Hold absent or shared contact
workflow.detail: Do not infer or append a private number, and do not call a shared office or answering-service line a direct owner contact.

workflow.label: Contact and owner-evidence gates
workflow.detail: Require independent owner evidence plus line-type, live, DNC, suppression, and delivery-dedupe checks.

workflow.label: Hold failed evidence
workflow.detail: Keep non-mobile, unreachable, suppressed, DNC, or owner-unconfirmed cases out of owner-confirmed delivery.

workflow.label: Deliver supported contact
workflow.detail: Deliver only when every permitted-contact and independent owner-evidence gate passes.

edges.label: unavailable, HTML error, or ineligible source
all contact and owner gates pass

failures.risk: An Issued MN Master license expiring on the current date is excluded before eligibility assessment.
failures.mitigation: Use an MN-specific parsed-date predicate that accepts Exp_Date equal to today; retain Issued and Master-level filters.

failures.risk: A Personal licensee is represented as a confirmed owner.
failures.mitigation: Keep Personal provenance as a license-role candidate and require independent owner evidence before owner labeling.

failures.risk: A Business row or Phone_No is represented as a direct owner mobile.
failures.mitigation: Retain business-contact provenance only and require reuse, line-type, live, DNC, suppression, dedupe, and owner-evidence gates.

failures.risk: A shared DLI phone reaches verification because reuse is not measured across distinct businesses and people.
failures.mitigation: Count the MN cohort's distinct business names and persons per normalized phone; hold values over two businesses or three persons as catalogued.

failures.risk: An unsupported category returns an HTTP-200 HTML error page that is accepted as source data.
failures.mitigation: Keep the adapter header/content assertion and hold unavailable category routes.

sources.label: MN DLI CCLD license export CSVs
sources.scope: Electrical and Plumbing licensee identity, class, status, address, and published business-phone candidates; Master-level cohort only.
sources.reference: handoff/04_SOURCE_CATALOG.md line 19 and MN row; handoff/07_RESEARCH_BUILD_SPEC.md MN row; src/lib/lead-engine-registers.ts mnDli

sources.label: MN DLI phone-reuse rule
sources.scope: Phone may be reused up to 189 licenses; threshold is more than two distinct businesses or more than three distinct persons.

sources.label: MN Data Practices source-use note
sources.scope: Prior research reports no solicitation restriction seen and public licensee name, license, and business address; recheck source terms before a live run.

sources.label: MN DLI adapter
sources.scope: Electrical and Plumbing CSV parser with Master, Issued, expiry, and HTML-content gates.
sources.reference: src/lib/lead-engine-registers.ts mnDli and mnDliRecord; tests/lead-engine-registers.test.ts mn_dli

iterations.hypothesis: The MN parser accepts an Issued Master license that remains valid through its listed expiration date while keeping business-only and unsupported rows out of the owner branch.
iterations.test: Five-case local fixture/code audit on 2026-09-24 using mnDliRecord: Personal Master expiring today; Personal Master expiring tomorrow; Business Master; non-Issued Master; and non-Master Electrical Contractor. No network request or contact data retention.
iterations.observed: The tomorrow-expiring Personal Master was kept as a named role candidate; the Business Master was kept without a person; non-Issued and non-Master rows were rejected. The expiry-today Personal Master was rejected as expired because mnDliRecord calls inFuture and inFuture requires date strictly greater than today.
iterations.change: Propose a local MN expiry predicate, expires !== null && expires >= today(), plus an expiry-day regression fixture. Keep Master, status, source-content, role, reuse, and downstream contact gates unchanged.

measurement.result: Synthetic five-case mnDliRecord audit only: expiry-today Issued Personal Master rejected; expiry-tomorrow Personal Master kept; Business Master kept without person; non-Issued Master rejected; non-Master Electrical Contractor rejected. This measures code behavior only, not source coverage, mobile line type, DNC, reachability, ownership, or delivery.

cost.basis: Local fixture/code audit only; no provider, paid verification, or source request
cost.note: No clean delivered owner contact was measured. The contractor_mn brain estimate has a different denominator and is not a per-clean cost for this workflow.

implementation.summary: The MN DLI adapter safely limits source categories, detects HTML error content, and filters to Issued Master rows, but it rejects expiry-day licenses through a strict shared future-date predicate. Owner confirmation and the catalogued distinct-business/person phone-reuse rule are not implemented by this adapter.

nextMeasurement: After the MN expiry-day regression is added, run an eligible bounded aggregate-only public-source sample reporting Master/status/Personal-Business and reuse counts without retaining contacts. A later authorized outcome study must separately measure line type, DNC, reachability, independent owner confirmation, and delivery before assigning a clean rate or per-clean cost.
